signature: SUBROUTINE ZLASCL( TYPE, KL, KU, CFROM, CTO, M, N, A, LDA, INFO )

params.name: type
params.reference:
`TYPE` indices the storage type of the input matrix.

-   `= 'G'`: A is a full matrix.
-   `= 'L'`: A is a lower triangular matrix.
-   `= 'U'`: A is an upper triangular matrix.
-   `= 'H'`: A is an upper Hessenberg matrix.
-   `= 'B'`: A is a symmetric band matrix with lower bandwidth `KL` and upper bandwidth `KU` and with the only the lower half stored.
-   `= 'Q'`: A is a symmetric band matrix with lower bandwidth `KL` and upper bandwidth `KU` and with the only the upper half stored.
-   `= 'Z'`: A is a band matrix with lower bandwidth `KL` and upper bandwidth `KU`. See ZGBTRF for storage details.

params.name: kl
params.reference: The lower bandwidth of A. Referenced only if `TYPE = 'B'`, 'Q' or 'Z'.

params.name: ku
params.reference: The upper bandwidth of A. Referenced only if `TYPE = 'B'`, 'Q' or 'Z'.

params.name: cto
params.reference: The matrix A is multiplied by `CTO`/`CFROM`. `A(I,J)` is computed without over/underflow if the final result $\mathrm{CTO} \, A(I,J)/\mathrm{CFROM}$ can be represented without over/underflow. `CFROM` must be nonzero.

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: The matrix to be multiplied by `CTO`/`CFROM`. See `TYPE` for the storage type.

params.name: lda
params.reference:
The leading dimension of the array A. If `TYPE = 'G'`, 'L', 'U', 'H', $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$;

$$
\mathrm{TYPE} = \text{'B'}, \mathrm{LDA} \ge \mathrm{KL}+1
$$

$$
\mathrm{TYPE} = \text{'Q'}, \mathrm{LDA} \ge \mathrm{KU}+1
$$

$$
\mathrm{TYPE} = \text{'Z'}, \mathrm{LDA} \ge 2 \, \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1
$$

params.name: info
params.reference: 0 - successful exit \<0 - if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.

checks.fortran: KU.LT.0 .OR. KU.GT.MAX( N-1, 0 ) .OR. ( ( ITYPE.EQ.4 .OR. ITYPE.EQ.5 ) .AND. KL.NE.KU )
( ITYPE.EQ.4 .AND. LDA.LT.KL+1 ) .OR. ( ITYPE.EQ.5 .AND. LDA.LT.KU+1 ) .OR. ( ITYPE.EQ.6 .AND. LDA.LT.2*KL+KU+1 )
